title: Floral Memory

outfit_card.silhouette: High-waisted fit-and-flare dress with a full, voluminous A-line skirt and a broad sculpted waist sash; smooth sleeveless bodice balances the sweeping skirt volume; a subtle back bustle adds couture dimension, paired with opera-length gloves and dark heels.
outfit_card.headpiece_and_hair_ornaments: A large structured bow in charcoal grey silk tulle crowns the head, accented by tiny pearl-tipped pins and a whisper of star-shaped silver hair jewelry scattered across the crown.
outfit_card.upper_garment_and_sleeves: Sleeveless high-neck bodice of white cotton-blend voile, featuring vertical pintuck pleats and a sheer organza neck ruffle; the high collar is finished with a black ribbon tie and pearl buttons; elbow-length charcoal suede gloves with a pearl wrist button.
outfit_card.lower_garment_and_legwear: Full A-line skirt with soft sunray pleats, layered over a light petticoat; deep navy tulle overlay embellished with trailing silver starbursts and floral embroidery; a wide navy silk waist sash tied in a structured bow; ankle-strap navy heels with a modest block heel.
outfit_card.signature_props_and_motifs: A luminous golden butterfly hovering above the gloved hand, scattering starry dust; translucent floating floral and star motifs; a constellation-embroidered sheer veil worn as a capelet.
